div.head: IV Eg 1.6
div.ab: Ðonne wille ic, þæt þás Godes gerihta standan æghwær gelice on minum anwealde.
Ðonne wille ic, þæt ðas Godes gerihta standan ægðer gelice on minum anwealde.
Uolo ętiam, ut hoc decretum stabile ác firmum in omnibus locis dominationis nostrę perseueret.
Ðonne wille ic, þæt ðas Godes gerihta standan æghwær gelice on minum anwealde;
Ferner will ich, dass diese Kirchen-Gerechtsame überall in meinem Gebiete gleichmässig gelten.
Further I will that these dues of God stand equally everywhere in my dominion.
Further, it is my will that these ecclesiastical dues be everywhere alike throughout my dominion.
Further, it is my will that these dues of God shall be alike everywhere in my dominion.

note.seg: Schreiber verliest ƿ als þ und ge als besonderes Wort
the scribe misreads ƿ as þ and ge as a separate word
Nicht bloss in der Engla-lagu, sondern auch bei den Nordleuten und Kelten, denen sonst ihr Sonderrecht bleibt; 2. 2. 1; 2. 12. 14. Vgl. Gl Partikularrecht 5.—Zu nostrae der Versio vgl. o. 1, 4¹
Not only in the Engla-lagu, but also among the Northmen and Celts, who otherwise keep their own particular law; 2. 2. 1; 2. 12. 14. Cf. Gl Partikularrecht 5.—On the Versio’s nostrae cf. above 1, 4¹
i.e., possibly, among the Danish and Celtic parts of the population as well as among the English, cf. 2, 2.
